model_entry_assumption: already entered __hci_init; outer caller requires prior ret==0 && !HCI_UNCONFIGURED && !HCI_USER_CHANNEL at hci_core.c:1501-1504, not modeled by this matrix
source_entry_condition: stage1/2 sync nonnegative && dev_type==HCI_PRIMARY && stage3 sync nonnegative && stage4 DLE feature true

LE_variable_qualification.means: LMP_LE capability at features[0][4], defined by lmp_le_capable
LE_variable_qualification.LE_false_DLE_true_source_result: target call still attempted if primary and preceding modeled stages succeed
LE_variable_qualification.LE_false_DLE_true_hardware_state: not established; possible inconsistent capability injection
LE_variable_qualification.stage_state_update_limit: LE off skips LE feature and max/default data-length reads; fixed injected state/value is not the real device-response chain

actual_queue_qualification: hci_req_add attempt is not skb queue success; req->err must be zero and hci_prepare_cmd allocation/copy must succeed before skb_queue_tail
coverage_conclusion: all selected four-boolean source condition combinations, not all initialization states or real architectures/devices
